row.reason: Both make test and measurement instruments and sell them B2B, including to aerospace and defense, with calibration and repair services. The overlap is partial. AMETEK is a diversified maker of analytical instruments, sensors, electromechanical motors and connectors, and thermal management systems for industrial, medical, power and process markets. Viavi focuses on network and telecom test and assurance, plus optical coatings and anti-counterfeiting pigments. Its main customers are carriers, data centers and equipment makers. So the product overlap is limited to general test and measurement, and the customer overlap is limited to aerospace and defense.
